scope: Same reviewed16assets/body, original2publicationreviews plus new2transportreviews and exact actual orchestration/bridge/plan. Only existing evidence ref and merged PR body. No production source branch, merge, issue, review/comment/settings actions.
transport_reason: CLI read authentication succeeds and fork push permission is true, but first Git blob POST returned HTTP401 Bad credentials with no cached blob/tree/commit/ref/body writes; connector profile independently identifies the same account. No credential extraction or authentication/settings change.
recovery: Single orchestrator only; content addressed blob identity checked, commit outcome held before POST; expected parent lease/force false and exact merged/head/body guards, readback every asset and body. On any error stop, inspect original receipts; never blindly rerun writes or an uncertain commit. Local verified-payload chunks are700000base64 characters, below observed stdout limit.
limitations: Optimistic head/body checks are not an atomic compare-and-swap; whole multi-step publication is not crash-atomic. Do not claim source gate or model offline deployment. Original failed CLI scripts/records/reviews unchanged.
